description:
Activate Ludevic by paying {1}{U}{U}{B}{B} and exiling Mirror-Mad Phantasm from your graveyard, transforming Ludevic into a copy of Mirror-Mad Phantasm with the name Olag, Ludevic's Hubris instead.
Activate Olag by paying {1}{U}, shuffling Olag into your library and putting your library into your graveyard due to it not containing a card named Mirror-Mad Phantasm in it.
